title: 2026-10-25 News
lede: It's a thin day for your research: nothing today touches peer review, citation analysis or scientific writing directly. The main story is DeepSeek DeepInfer, an open-source inference system reported to serve 155T tokens a day per cluster. The rest is mostly a round of mid-size model releases, including DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and MiniMax M3.1 Flash, plus some podcasts and explainers.
